name: Quincy Market — adapted hall

recipe.name: Quincy Market — adapted hall
recipe.period: 1826 exterior vocabulary with an explicitly adapted later open rotunda
recipe.adaptation: Central Quincy Market only. HABS MA-1166 sheet 1 supplies partial exterior evidence; sheets 2/3 depict separate North/South Market buildings and are not hall plans. The city report grounds the long aisle, stall rows, Doric porticos, dome and later rotunda opening. The 153 m body plus two 3 m porticos, 3 m bays, stall arrangement, native stair cores and rectangular balcony opening are authored adaptations; the source later oval opening and nineteenth-century interiors are not conflated.
